source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Having an unusually wide therapeutic index overall, with fairly little risk of toxicity even at somewhat higher doses","B":"Requiring fairly little ongoing monitoring at all once the client's therapy has first been established and stabilized","C":"Carrying fairly little risk of interacting with any of the client's other prescribed medications over time","D":"Has a narrow therapeutic index, meaning toxicity can occur at levels not far above the therapeutic range, requiring careful monitoring"}}
source_row.rationale: Theophylline has a narrow therapeutic index, meaning toxicity (which can include serious cardiac and neurological effects) can occur at levels not far above the therapeutic range, requiring careful, ongoing serum level monitoring, particularly important given its many potential drug interactions.
source_row.source_detail: Narrow Therapeutic Index and Monitoring Needs
